ThE AUThORS Charles Poynton is an independent contractor specializing in the physics, mathematics, and engineering of digital colour imaging systems, including digital video, HD/UHD, and digital cinema (D-cinema). He does technology forecasting, systems modelling, algorithm development, video signal processing architecture, color characterization and calibration, and image quality assessment. He lives and works in Toronto, Canada.
